figma.intro: Connect your Figma account so the AI can read design files, components, styles, and comments—then help analyze designs, extract specs, or suggest improvements.

media.userPrompt: Help me analyze the design system on this page
media.assistantReply: Sure — here’s an analysis of this page…

features: Read files, pages, components, and styles
Extract colors, type, and spacing specs
Generate design analysis and improvement ideas

quotes: Design analysis is spot on and saves me a lot of time.
Pulling specs straight from the file is so convenient.
Collaboration with the team leveled up.

github.intro: Connect GitHub so the AI can work with Issues, PRs, and repository context—for reviews, debugging, and team coordination.

media.userPrompt: Summarize the risk of this PR
media.assistantReply: I reviewed the diff and related Issues. Main risks are…

features: Read repositories, Issues, and Pull Requests
Assist code review and change summaries
Help draft Issues and PR descriptions

items: Write collaborative updates within the granted scope

quotes: Great for debugging with Issue context.

notion.intro: Connect your Notion workspace so the AI can read and organize pages, notes, and databases—then help search and summarize.

items: Read pages and databases you authorize

quotes: Pulling Notion context for summaries is effortless.
Project docs are much easier to search.
